note: Battle Drama Engine slice 2: the rare-event library (guide §5 and Phase 6). 'planned' events need systems that do not exist yet. Checks live in core/drama/events.ts. Placeholders: {name} enemy Pokémon, {foe} yours, {foeMove} your repeated move.

events.name: Last-Second Resolve
events.requires: Enemy Pokémon has a Hyper moment (existing story rules apply the effect)
lines: {name} holds on... and so do I!
Steady, {name}. Not yet.

events.name: The Refusal
events.requires: A willful Pokémon (autonomy 60+) that distrusts you (trust 35 or less) refuses a reckless command (one that would faint it), once per battle. Foreshadowed by the 'wary' mood
lines: Your {foe} would not follow that order. It doesn't trust you to ask that of it.
Did your {foe} just refuse you? That kind of order costs trust.

events.name: The New Move
events.requires: A Pokémon at half HP reveals the strongest valid learnset move it doesn't know (yours: trust 70+ and sync 60+; a rival's: a confident Pokémon)
lines: Where did that move come from? It was keeping it hidden!
So that is what they have been working on.
events.remember: I have been working on {foeMove} ever since our last battle.

events.name: The Tactical Revelation
events.requires: You really used the same move 3 times in this battle
lines: You keep leaning on {foeMove}. I see the pattern now.
That is the third {foeMove}. I know what you are doing.
events.remember: Last time you leaned on {foeMove}. Not happening again.

events.name: The Comeback Call
events.requires: Enemy Pokémon falls below the low-HP line for the first time
lines: Don't give up, {name}! I believe in you!
Get up, {name}! We're not done!

events.name: The Ace Reveal
events.requires: Final Pokémon of a team of 3+ is sent out
lines: This is my ace. {name}, show them everything!
I saved the best for last. Go, {name}!

events.name: The Unplanned Combination
events.requires: A practiced pair (open Bond relationship, sync 50+ each) hands over after a faint: the partner starts with +1 in its attacking stat, once per pair per battle
lines: That hand-over was practiced. They moved as one!
A coordinated switch, and it was not for show.

events.name: The Failed Technique
events.requires: A signature move of the enemy misses
lines: It missed! We still need more practice.
Not yet... we'll get it right next time.
events.remember: I have been practicing that move since we last met.

events.name: The Overdrive Breakthrough
events.requires: Owned by the Overdrive/Hyper thread

events.name: The Overdrive Misfire
events.requires: Owned by the Overdrive/Hyper thread

events.name: The Veteran's Adjustment
events.requires: Turn 4+, the enemy has lost a Pokémon and you have not lost one
lines: Hm. My opening plan is not working. Time to change it.
All right, new approach.

events.name: The Desperate Switch
events.requires: The trainer swaps out a Pokémon that did not faint
lines: Come back! Someone else has a better answer!
Hold on, {name}. I have a different idea.

events.name: The Rival Interruption
events.requires: A big battle (gym, boss or rival) with another living rival who is not on cooldown; they meet and form a lasting relationship
lines: So this is the battle everyone is talking about. Don't mind me, I'm only watching.
I heard about this one. I had to see how it ends.

events.name: The Unfinished Grudge
events.requires: Rival lost to you last time and sends out its ace
lines: I have not forgotten how you beat us. Not for a second.
Last time you won. This time {name} remembers.

events.name: The Mercy Moment
events.requires: Kind trainer; your Pokémon is nearly down
lines: I won't press that. You've fought hard.
...Let's end this fairly, you and I.
events.remember: I used to think winning was all that mattered. I don't think that anymore.

events.name: The Breaking Point
events.requires: Enemy lost half its team and you lost none
lines: This can't be happening!
No... no, I can't lose like this!

events.name: The Calm Before the Finish
events.requires: Last enemy Pokémon is out on turn 3+ and the trainer is calm or grim
lines: (The trainer says nothing and watches closely.)

events.name: The Pokémon Takes Initiative
events.requires: A Pokémon with sync 70+ and trust 60+ swaps a command that cannot hurt the foe for its best move that can, in the same turn, once per battle
lines: Your {foe} did not wait to be told. It changed the move itself!
They don't even need orders. That Pokémon read the situation.

events.name: The Rematch Reversal
events.requires: Rival has a recorded adaptation from the rematch counter-pick
lines: Last time that plan cost me. This time I do the opposite.
You beat my old strategy. So I changed it.

events.name: The Unexpected Respect
events.requires: The enemy's ace falls
lines: Impressive. That Pokémon is truly strong.
I have to respect that.
events.remember: I spent weeks figuring out how you broke through our defense with {foeMove}.

events.name: Pokémon Recognition
events.requires: The rival's Pokémon was on the team you fought last time, and your active Pokémon fought it that day
lines: {name} stares at {foe}. Those two have met before.
That look... {name} has not forgotten {foe}.

events.name: The Emotional Turning Point
events.requires: A Pokémon felt the same thing three times in this battle (determination, bravery, perseverance, justice or patience)
lines: Something changed in {name}. It's a different Pokémon now!
{name}, I can see it in your eyes!
events.remember: You saw it, didn't you? The moment my partner found its {foeMove}.

events.name: The Breakthrough Evolution
events.requires: A rival's training Pokémon (brought in a stage below its final form, already at its evolution level) evolves at a turn boundary after turn 3 or at half HP
lines: {name}... you've evolved! I knew you could!
This is what all our training was for! Show them, {name}!
events.remember: You remember the battle where {foeMove} evolved, don't you? It has only grown since.

warning: Brace yourself! Here comes the big one!
promise: I told you we'd master this together. {move}!
personalCallback: Remember the move that beat us last time? We fixed it. {move}!

hit: That's the power of our training!
